name: Safari
lore: The road heads out onto the warm savanna, where lions doze, elephants splash at the waterhole, giraffes nibble the treetops and zebras, rhinos and hippos go about their day under a big golden sky.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's Safari (African safari animals; per Peter 10/13, portraits in front of a real setting and scenes with something happening on a savanna, river or jungle background, no plain colours and no band edit; scenes where the animal melts or is small left out), 38 picks (22 portraits, 16 scenes) and 12 spares, cut to 28 (18 portraits, 10 scenes) in workspace fd4671d after lane D's phase-1 bake and pre-read, then 14 refill portraits in real settings added in a0bad2b and 3 of them dropped in 80b23ee: 39 played (29 portraits, 10 scenes), 20 spares (see mainNote) (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/18-safari/README.md, picks-full.json, workspaces 35e0c62, fd4671d, a0bad2b and 80b23ee). No edits (edits.json empty). Kind painting, shade on, converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The 59 manifest lines are lane C's (80b23ee), whole; lane D filled only the empty url with the seed and where the prompt sits (Holiday Lights' words). The folder keeps lane C's slug (18); as installed it is Land 14 in the factory's numbering (era 22) and Zen World 15.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (tools/map-plan-v7.md section 8; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots (23 at (587,808) (300,430); 13 at (637,1101) (352,293), the far-apart pair of its three spurs), each repeat its own pair, as the plan gives them, trimmed to the 3 + 2 repeats 39 levels lay. Kinds for the savanna: grass tufts, a raven (a vulture), glints, and reeds, fish and bubbles at the waterholes.

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

mainNote: Lane C's 39 (picks-full.json landMain, workspace 80b23ee: the 28 of fd4671d plus 11 refill portraits in real settings, sf2NN, interleaved; lane C dropped sf216 Lioness and cub, Mufasa-and-Simba framing, sf220 Crowned crane, red cheek reads as a smear, and sf208 Flamingo pair, second bird a speck, from a0bad2b's 14; the 28 are lane C's 38 less sf021 Buffalo and sf020 Pelican, too easy on lane D's phase-1 bake; sf029 Zebra crossing, sf035 Monkey swing, sf036 Croc and bird, sf041b Elephant family, sf048 Pelican catch, sf019 Okapi, muddy; sf047b Baboon on a rock, too close to Rafiki on Pride Rock; sf017 Warthog, with a lion it nears the Lion King pairing). map.note: v7 lever 1: no new image bytes. tools/map-plan-v7.md section 8: castle sheet 23 (dry open ground, scrub, rocks and a hut cluster: the savanna) and sheet 13 (the Mistmoor pools as watering holes, reused from Cloud Kingdom, Zen World 11, four worlds apart under the opposite pale-sky tint, so the plan's 22/23 fallback is not needed) through map.fromLayout, alternately mirrored, under one golden-tan tint, yellower than Harvest and lighter than National Park. 13's pools go olive-khaki, muddy dry-season waterholes. 39 levels: 5 sheets, 8+8+8+8+7 (A x3, B x2).
